answers.DOES_APEX_ROUTE_EXIST_IN_CODE: NO — server.js has no pathname === '/' handler; matchRoute() returns null and the request falls to fail(res,'NOT_FOUND','Route not found',404).
answers.DOES_APEX_HAVE_CUSTOMER_SURFACE: A landing entry EXISTS (app/landing/index.html, app/frontend/index.html, dist landing bundle) but is deliberately NOT mounted at '/'.
answers.DOES_APEX_INTENTIONALLY_404: YES — governed and test-locked, not accidental.
answers.IS_THERE_A_TEST_ASSERTING_404: YES — tests/ui/admin_surface_serve.test.js asserts status 404, content-type application/json, the exact NOT_FOUND envelope body, and that '/' must NOT serve landing HTML.
answers.WAS_THAT_BEHAVIOUR_LATER_CHANGED: NO — 835afb1 (2026-07-26) 'fix(workcaptain): keep apex unchanged while repairing admin'. Only 2 commits touched app/server.js after it (a69c635 CSP, 73a61e2 CI); neither released the apex.
answers.IS_STAGE_H_STILL_GOVERNING: SD-WC-DOMAIN-001 records DNS cutover as Stage H and non-blocking for build lanes. Nothing measured this run contradicts it.
answers.IS_CURRENT_DNS_STATE_MEASURABLE: NO — not attempted. AWS/Route53 read credentials absent.
answers.IS_CURRENT_INGRESS_STATE_MEASURABLE: NO — ALB/listener/target-group state requires AWS read credentials, which are absent.

ec_001_3_admin_repair: 835afb1 repaired /admin (it had served the landing entry whose absolute /assets/* references were unmounted -> JS 404 -> empty skip-link shell) while explicitly preserving the apex 404.
defect_found: tests/ui/admin_surface_serve.test.js is NOT on the scripts/ci_gate_tests.js manifest, so the apex lock is asserted locally only and proves nothing about any pushed commit.
explicitly_not_inferred: No claim is made about live HTTP behaviour at the public apex. Only code and git history were measured.
